metadata.description: Dense multi-clause architectural description testing prompt capacity and detail retention
metadata.prompt: In an ultra-detailed futuristic retro-cyberpunk laboratory filled with antique brass gauges, flickering vacuum tubes, holographic wireframes rotating at 30 degrees inclination, a robotic arm with polished chrome knuckles carefully unscrews a glowing blue quartz crystal container while green smoke eddies across a wet steel diamond-plate floor illuminated by neon purple overhead signage, 35mm anamorphic.
